summary: Grupo Televisa filed a Form 6-K for May 2026, reporting full-year and Q4 2025 financial results under IFRS. The filing describes a segment reorganization merging Cable and Sky into a single Telecom segment, with restated comparatives. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or special situation is announced. The filing is a routine earnings release with management commentary and financial statements, not a special-situation event under the defined categories.
